justification: Inspected `ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/main/ClassMemberList.java` (386 lines) plus `ClassTree.java` and `JITWatchUI.java` for context. `ClassMemberList` combines several separable responsibilities in one class: it builds and lays out the UI (`VBox`, `CheckBox`, `ListView`), persists the compiled-members filter to `JITWatchConfig`, handles selection change notification to listeners, constructs and dispatches multiple context-menu actions, computes intrinsics via `IntrinsicFinder`, and manages programmatic selection/state syncing. The class also contains a nested `MetaMethodCell` for rendering. This mix of UI composition, configuration, event routing, business lookup, and cell rendering indicates insufficient modularization.
